general.readOnly: You can view these settings but not change them.

publicUrl.helper: The address people use to reach Bayplan. If Bayplan runs under a path, include it, for example https://example.com/bayplan. It controls cookies and request origin checks.

agentUrl.label: Agent URL
agentUrl.helper: Leave empty to use the public URL. Set it if your hosts reach Bayplan at a different address, such as an internal hostname.
agentUrl.locked: Set by the BAYPLAN_AGENT_URL environment variable.
agentUrl.insecure: Agents refuse a plain http address for another host. Use an https address. For development only, start Bayplan with BAYPLAN_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE=true.
agentUrl.refused: Agents can't connect to this Bayplan. They would dial {{endpoint}}, a plain ws:// address for another host, which agents refuse, and so does Bayplan. Set an https agent URL above, or give Bayplan an https public URL. For development only, BAYPLAN_AGENT_ALLOW_INSECURE=true on Bayplan allows it.

confirm.title: Change the public URL?
confirm.body: You're using Bayplan at {{origin}}. If the new address doesn't match how you reach Bayplan, you may be signed out and requests can be blocked.
confirm.agentsTold: Agents connected over wss:// are sent the new address now and switch to it on their next connection, if it's also a wss:// address. Agents on plain ws:// aren't told. From now on Bayplan refuses agents that dial a different host or port: there's no fallback period.
confirm.offline_one: {{count}} agent is offline. It can't learn the new address, and Bayplan will refuse it until you reinstall it with the new address or change the URL back.
confirm.offline_other: {{count}} agents are offline. They can't learn the new address, and Bayplan will refuse them until you reinstall them with the new address or change the URL back.

rename.title: Rename environment
rename.description: Choose how this environment is named across Bayplan.

errors.invalid: Enter a name of 1 to 64 characters.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {{name}}?
removeConfirm.body: Bayplan will stop managing this host. Containers, images, volumes and networks on it are not changed. You can add it again in Settings.
